access_mode: hybrid: local embedding model (approved) + team-provided Anthropic API for generation/extraction

embedding.endpoint_or_local_command: in-process: fastembed.TextEmbedding('BAAI/bge-base-en-v1.5'); first use downloads Qdrant/bge-base-en-v1.5-onnx-Q into FASTEMBED_CACHE_PATH
embedding.max_batch_size: 32 texts per ONNX batch (implementation choice; no provider limit for a local model)
embedding.requests_per_minute: not applicable (local, no provider rate limit)
embedding.sanitized_smoke_request_instructions: uv run potency smoke  (embeds two synthetic sentences; checks 768 dims and unit norm)

generation.api_style_and_version: Anthropic Messages API, anthropic-version 2023-06-01, python SDK 1.13.0
generation.model_id_and_version: claude-sonnet-5-5 (supplied by DeffAI; set via ANTHROPIC_MODEL in .env; response model recorded in results/access-check.json and every trace)
generation.context_window_tokens: not confirmed by DeffAI; prompts are designed to stay below 30k input tokens
generation.max_output_tokens: not confirmed by DeffAI; implementation requests at most 12000 (extraction) / 8000 (answers; raised from 4000 after one truncated answer)
generation.requests_per_minute: not confirmed by DeffAI; client limits concurrency to POTENCY_EXTRACTION_CONCURRENCY=4 and retries 429/5xx with SDK backoff (max_retries=6)
generation.max_concurrent_requests: not confirmed by DeffAI; implementation uses <= 4
generation.structured_output: json_schema (claude-sonnet-5-5 rejects forced tool_choice, so output_config.format={type: json_schema} is used with the same closed schema; outputs re-validated locally)
generation.usage_reporting: response.usage input/output/cache tokens recorded per call in usage_ledger and results/usage.json
generation.sanitized_smoke_request_instructions: uv run potency smoke  (one plain synthetic prompt + one structured-output call: forced tool use is attempted, and the json_schema output_config fallback is what succeeded; writes results/access-check.json)

credentials.secure_delivery_method: Delivered by DeffAI out of band; placed by the candidate in the git-ignored .env file
credentials.note: Record delivery instructions and environment-variable names only; never store a credential value here.

budget.candidate_total_limit: not stated in this sheet by DeffAI; candidate-side hard guard POTENCY_MAX_USD=40 stops model calls when the estimated spend reaches it
budget.usage_visibility: local ledger (usage_ledger/model_spend tables) + results/usage.json; provider console not available to candidate
budget.near_limit_and_exhaustion_procedure: Budget guard raises BudgetExceeded before a call; extraction records budget_stop and the run is reported incomplete. Contact DeffAI before any further spend.

api_constraints.retry_and_backoff_guidance: SDK exponential backoff on 429/5xx, max_retries=6; failed batches are recorded, not hidden
api_constraints.network_or_allowlist_requirements: outbound HTTPS to api.anthropic.com; huggingface.co once for the local model download
api_constraints.other_constraints: Sampling parameters (temperature) are not accepted by the SDK 1.13 Messages API; default sampling is used, so repeated runs can differ

local_alternative.generation_model_version_quantization: none approved; generation uses the hosted model only
local_alternative.hardware_requirements_and_provider: CPU only, ~0.5 GB RAM for the model; full 791-record index ~20-30 min on a 4-thread laptop CPU
local_alternative.startup_instructions: uv sync; first `uv run potency index` downloads the model into .cache/fastembed
local_alternative.fallback_if_unavailable: If hosted generation is unavailable: pause timed work and contact DeffAI; do not switch models silently

support.primary_name: DeffAI hiring contact (named in the assignment email; not recorded here)
